content.short: Lunar Capital focuses on empowering crypto projects with KOL fundraising and strategic investing.
content.description: Lunar Capital serves as the investment arm of Lunar Strategy, an ecosystem growth firm. Its mission is to connect great projects and ecosystems with the best influencers and content creators to build long-term relationships that endure beyond a single launch. The team brings substantial hands-on experience taking ideas from concept through to launched ecosystems and actively accelerates the growth of leading ecosystems across the space.
